newsitem.title: JAPAN: SESC recommends punishment for Naito Sec, Ark Sec.
newsitem.headline: SESC recommends punishment for Naito Sec, Ark Sec.

text.p: Japan's securities watchdog, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC), said on Friday it had recommended the finance minister to punish Naito Securities and Ark Securities for suspected illegal deals.
The SESC did not say what kind of punishment it had recommended to the minister.
Osaka-based Naito is an affiliate of Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd and Nagoya-based Ark is an independent firm.
The SESC said in a statement that the suspected illegal deals by Naito included compensating clients for losses in 1992.
The suspected illegal deals by Ark included discretionary deals conducted by its employees between 1993 to 1997, the SESC said.
A discretionary deal is one in which a brokerage trades a client's shares on its own initiative without the required instructions from a client.
Compensation of losses from stock deals and discretionary deals by brokerages for customers are banned under Japanese law.
